name: joplin-plugin-hue-md
description: Hue MD for Joplin: colored spans, diff spans, key caps, progress bars, multi-state tasks and drawn callout boxes in the note viewer.
author: spingras

scripts.dist: node scripts/write-css.js && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
